description: This file contains the ASP.NET Core MVC controller 'ArticlesController' which handles HTTP requests related to article resources in the web API. It includes endpoints for retrieving lists of articles, article details, creating, editing, and deleting articles, utilizing MediatR for command/query handling and ASP.NET Core attributes for routing and authorization.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core MVC controller for article-related API endpoints, handling creation, retrieval, update, and deletion of articles.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of articles based on optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a personalized feed of articles.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve details of a specific article identified by slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST request to create a new article, requires authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT request to update an existing article specified by slug, requires authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE request to remove an article specified by slug, requires authorization.
